messages:
alex: Quick idea — prototyping a new 'anchor' command for deploy-bot to pin a canary to a QA snapshot + embedded escape hatch. Want quick feedback before I wire it into orchestrator.

alex: Usage I'm thinking of:
```/deploy anchor --env=staging --service=auth --pin=auth@v1.2.3 --window=90m --escape-hatch='rollback:auth@v1.2.2' --dry-run``` 

alex: Behavior: lock canary traffic to pinned image, annotate release notes with pinned version, start a health-check watch (preflight + periodic) and auto-unlock after window unless extended. If preflight fails, emit a canary-failed event and optionally run escape-hatch.

maya: Love the annotation part. Can we have optional `--notes-template` so release engineering can inject short changelog? Eg `--notes-template="QA anchor: {{service}} pinned to {{pin}} — reason: {{reason}}"`

sam: Two safety asks: 1) require a passing 'smoke' check before pin takes effect, 2) require `--approve` from either persona with deploy perms if escape-hatch will auto-run destructive ops.

alex: Yep to both. Default is no destructive auto-rollback unless `--auto-rollback=true` and an approver is provided or pre-approved via ACL. Smoke checks run with `--preflight=smoke` by default.

taylor: Can we standardize change window format? `--window` hours/mins ok but I'd prefer ISO duration, e.g. `PT1H30M` so tooling can parse consistently. Also add `--tz` so ops shows the human window in channel.

alex: Good call, switch to ISO durations. We'll show local timezone by default and include UTC in the pinned annotation.

jen: What about pin semantics across dependent services? If auth@v1.2.3 requires sessions@v2.0.0, we should be able to attach multi-pin like `--pin=auth@v1.2.3,sessions@v2.0.0`. Also allow `--compat-check` to run a lightweight integration smoke.

alex: Implementing multi-pin. `--compat-check` will run a quick contract test matrix (configurable). If it fails, the command will present the failure in-thread and won't apply pin unless `--force` provided with approver.

sam: Example escape-hatch templates please. For us, escape-hatch is usually a rollback to previous stable tag, but sometimes a one-off hotfix. Could we let it run a script? `--escape-hatch='script:/ops/run_hotfix.sh arg1'` ?

alex: Yes. Support `rollback:<tag>` and `script:<path>` for escape-hatch. Script runs in ops sandbox with limited env. Also capture output and post back to thread.

deploy-bot: :robot_face: draft command registered in sandbox: `/deploy anchor` — use `--help` for full options. Dry-run accepted.

maya: Release notes templating — we should add a small default template that auto-populates changed services, pins, window, owner, and links to prereq test logs. Something like:
```QA Anchor: {{owner}} pinned {{services}} for {{window}} (UTC: {{window_utc}}).
Reason: {{reason}}
Preflight: {{preflight_status}} — logs: {{preflight_url}}
Escape hatch: {{escape_hatch}}
``` 

taylor: Also include a short machine-friendly annotation that the console can parse for rollouts API, e.g. `X-Redwood-Deploy: anchor;services=auth,sessions;pin=auth@v1.2.3;window=PT1H` in the message metadata.

alex: We'll add both human and machine annotations. I'll push a PR for the bot handler + small helper lib for templates and ISO parsing. Plan to land a minimal v0 that only supports staging env and smoke preflight, then expand.

jen: Can we add a checklist quick command to generate a rollback playbook stub into the thread? Eg `/deploy anchor --generate-playbook` that posts a template with steps and who to ping.

alex: Nice. We'll generate: rollback commands, affected infra, monitoring links, toast message to SRE channel, and a one-click pin reversal button (requires approver).

sam: One operational nit: how do we surface latency/cost regressions? Anchor sometimes hides perf regressions. Maybe include `--perf-sampling` option to run token/latency probes against the canary endpoints.

alex: Adding `--perf-sampling=<profile>` that kicks off synthetic telemetry during the window and reports deltas. If regressions exceed thresholds we'll flag and optionally trigger the escape-hatch.

maya: Timeline: if we think this is low risk, can we do a small dogfood next week? I'd like to try anchor on an internal staging flow before rolling to customer-facing staging.

alex: Target: PR tomorrow, sandbox deploybot handler by midweek, dogfood Thursday. I'll post the PR link here and include a short README for release engineers.

taylor: Minor naming bikeshed: `anchor` vs `pin` vs `hold`. I vote for `anchor` since it's evocative.

jen: +1 anchor.

alex: OK anchor it is. I'll add `--notes-template` examples and the escape-hatch script sandbox details. Thanks all — will follow up with PR and demo thread.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: scheduled dry-run at 2167773400 for `/deploy anchor --env=staging --service=auth --pin=auth@v1.2.3 --window=PT1H30M --notes-template="QA anchor: {{service}} pinned to {{pin}} — reason: {{reason}}" --generate-playbook --dry-run`
